question: Under what circumstance must an MS-ADS applicant submit proof of English language proficiency?

pipeline_flatrag.answer:
Based on the retrieved context, an applicant to the Master's in Applied Data Science program must submit proof of English language proficiency if they do not meet the English Language Proficiency criteria [1]. The context does not specify the exact criteria for exemption, but it notes that applicants should review the waiver policy for details [1].

Sources:
1. [How To Apply | English Language Requirement](https://grad.uchicago.edu/admissions/apply/english-language-requirements/)

evidence.text:
[Page: How To Apply | Section: English Language Requirement]

Applicants to the Master’s in Applied Data Science program who do not meet the English Language Proficiency criteria must submit proof of English language proficiency. Minimum scores for the Master’s in Applied Data Science program: TOEFL: 102 (prior requirement) or 5 (current requirement; no subscore requirement); IELTS, 7 (no subscore requirement). Please review our waiver policy [here](https://grad.uchicago.edu/admissions/apply/english-language-requirements/) .
